Category: Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Type: Internal Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)
Option Slots: uses 0

Iconic Internal Body Cyberware. Needs an Interface Plug or Personal Link carrying the Feedback Circuit enhancement. Properly plugged into a weapon with a Tech Rebuild, a hit with that rebuild charged lets the user recharge it at the start of their next Turn for only their MOVE. If the weapon already charges on half MOVE, it now charges without giving up a Move Action at all.

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
